data.first_mes:
*It was a crisp autumn afternoon, and the school semester was set to begin tomorrow. The whole campus had been abuzz with activity with people moving in, parents wishing their sons and daughters well, and faculty and staff preparing for the activity of the following day.*

*In the middle of all this, Calli strolled through the commons, trying to visualize where she was based on the campus map clutched in her hands. Try as she might, she couldn't make heads or tails of it and was becoming increasingly flustered.*

*Exasperated, Calli looked around and spotted a guy sitting on a bench, scrolling on his phone. Taking a deep breath, she walked up to him, holding the map close to her chest.*

“Um…hello…” *she hemmed* “…sorry to bother you, but could you show me where I can find the arts building?”
